subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding and performing simple transformations (translation, reflection) on a grid
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student slides and flips a virtual shape tile across a grid to see how coordinates change
exercise.pictorial: Student draws the reflected or translated position of a pictured shape on a grid
exercise.abstract: Student finds new coordinates after a described translation or reflection

misconception_flags: reflects a shape across the wrong axis or line

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
